title: DART-VLN: Test-Time Memory Decay and Anti-Loop Regularization for Discrete Vision-Language Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2607.01043v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Memory-based agents for discrete vision-language navigation (VLN) operate under partial observability and may exhibit systematic inference-time failures even with strong pretrained backbones. This paper addresses two recurring problems: stale historical evidence during memory readout and inefficient local backtracking during action selection. We present DART-VLN, a training-free inference-time framework that combines Test-Time Memory Decay, which reweights stale and redundant memory slots without modifying their stored content, with Anti-Loop Regularization, a lightweight next-hop penalty that discourages immediate reversals. DART-VLN introduces no learnable parameters and leaves the navigation backbone unchanged. Experiments on R2R and REVERIE showed that memory decay preserved or improved task performance while reducing runtime. translated_title: DART-VLN：面向离散视觉语言导航的测试时记忆衰减与反循环正则化
translated_abstract: 基于记忆的离散视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体在部分可观测条件下运行，即使拥有强大的预训练骨干网络，也可能在推理阶段出现系统性的失败。本文针对两个反复出现的问题：记忆读取时的陈旧历史证据，以及动作选择时低效的局部回溯。我们提出了DART-VLN，这是一个无需训练的推理时框架，它将测试时记忆衰减（在不修改记忆槽存储内容的前提下，对陈旧和冗余的记忆槽进行重新加权）与反循环正则化（一种轻量级的下一跳惩罚机制，抑制立即折返）相结合。DART-VLN不引入任何可学习参数，并保持导航骨干网络完全不变。在R2R和REVERIE数据集上的实验表明，记忆衰减在保持或提升任务性能的同时降低了运行时间。加入反循环正则化后，轨迹进一步缩短，局部回溯也显著减少。
tldr: DART-VLN是一个无需训练的推理时框架，通过测试时记忆衰减和反循环正则化解决离散视觉语言导航中的记忆陈旧和局部回溯问题，在不修改骨干网络且不引入可学习参数的情况下提升性能并降低运行时间。
en_tdlr: DART-VLN is a training-free inference-time framework that combines test-time memory decay and anti-loop regularization to address stale memory evidence and inefficient local backtracking in discrete vision-language navigation, preserving or improving task performance while reducing runtime without modifying the navigation backbone.
